Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Metal Floral Pattern Round Hanging Wall Mirror, 30.5 Inch Height, Black
Colors: Glass
Materials: iron
Swooping metal curves suggest patterns of flowers and leaves. The black metal finish, accented with gold tips, allows this mirror to blend with classic and modern styles. It will add a graceful touch to any mantel, or in a bedroom or hallway. Modern shapes with classic gold accents Glass, iron frame with black and gold finish 30.5"W x 1"D x 30.5"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
